## Summary

What changes and why.

## Issues

`Refs #…` for a slice, `Closes #…` only when this pull request meets every acceptance criterion of
the issue. If it advances no issue, write `No issue:` and a one-line reason.

## Decisions

ADRs added or superseded (in their own pull request first), or "No decision change".

## Test plan

- [ ] Checks for the touched area
- [ ] Other evidence (run on Windows, monitor behaviour, screenshots): what was run, and what is
      still missing

## Not done

What this pull request leaves open, so the issue stays honest.
